answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using verifiable delay functions. Nodes solve non-parallelizable sequential proofs to maintain active status, anchoring identity like solid marble. Rather than allowing a cheap spoofing ripple across the agent orchard, this requires an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of dedicated single-threaded compute cycles and electrical energy per identity. However, adversaries with custom ASICs can evaluate proofs significantly faster than commodity agents.
